occupancy_cloud.name: Occupancy Cloud
occupancy_cloud.description: Occupancy of a region by a set has two independent parts - EXTENT, how much of the region the set covers, and SITE, where in the region it sits - and the corpus's two-member `occupancy` family gave the same word to a different one each. possibility_space_cloud varies extent (a 0.05 m knot at `pinched` against a 0.322 m clamped shell at `packed`, possibility_space_cloud.gd:159-167) and never moves the cloud out of the middle of its box. bifurcation_walkway varies site (_dot_position, bifurcation_walkway.gd:247-270): the identical 4800 dots, the identical colours, the identical r window, relocated onto a different submanifold of the same corridor. Zero shared values, and that is why. The word is not a coincidence - the walkway carries the cloud's coordinate too, under the name `regime` - but neither member can show the two coordinates at once. This bench is a 0.80 x 0.56 x 0.38 m phase box on a post holding the logistic map's attractor set: occupancy picks one of four disjoint r windows, from a single-attractor line to a chaotic band, and site puts that set in the box's air, against its far glass, on its floor with the value read across the depth, or above the box entirely. A readout counts the occupied fraction in the box's own state axis, in units of one drawn point, so it moves with occupancy and cannot move with site.

dna.default: occupancy=forked, site=suspended. site=suspended because it is the relation BOTH members ship: bifurcation_walkway's `corridor` is the `_:` fallthrough of _dot_position (:268-270) and hangs the cloud in the air at head height, and possibility_space_cloud's cloud floats at the centre of its phase box in every one of its five values. occupancy=forked is a free choice - this is a new body with zero placements and neither source ships an r window that is one of these four (the walkway ships `regime=all`, 2.5..4.0, which is all four windows at once) - and it is justified negatively: `hairline` would make the default photograph of this artifact a single line, which reads as a broken build, and `flooded` would ship the postcard every bifurcation diagram already is. `forked` is the smallest window in which the possibility space has an interior at all, which is the event the whole family is about.
dna.note:
IS THIS A FAMILY OR A WORD COINCIDENCE? IT IS A FAMILY, AND THE WORD IS AN HONEST EQUIVOCATION BETWEEN TWO COORDINATES OF ONE QUESTION. The evidence is not that the two artifacts feel similar; it is a translation test that passes on exactly the half it should and fails on exactly the other half.

THE STARTING SUSPICION WAS THAT THE WALKWAY'S FOUR VALUES ARE A MOUNTING AXIS. Mostly wrong, and the source says so first: its own dna.kin already names `support` (none|stand|frame|pylon) and `admission` (none|bench|residue|exhibit) as the mounting words it rejected, and its comment at :36-39 reads 'The alternatives are not mountings, they are different relations.' Two things in the code back that up. First, `inlay` (:259-263) does not move the diagram, it REWRITES it: the population value goes from y to z, so the cascade branches left and right across the corridor and the mapping itself rotates. No mounting axis changes which variable is on which axis. Second, the container here is human-scaled and player-aware - a 12 x 2 x 3 m corridor with an Area3D that detects the body (:473-484) and a _process that turns the player's x into r (:494-519) - so the relation the axis moves is between the state set and a body, not between an object and a display surface. Where the suspicion is RIGHT is that these four values say nothing about how full anything is, which is the cloud's entire subject.

THE TRANSLATION TEST. Take a vocabulary for EXTENT - how much of the space of what could be is covered - and try to translate both members' lists into it. possibility_space_cloud translates cleanly: pinched is a 0.05 m knot in a box whose inscribed limit is 0.322 m, packed clamps 48.8 percent of its points onto that limit shell, widened holds the same 0.45 m cloud and grows the box to 0.98 m so the same numerator gets a bigger denominator, and breath sweeps between the ends. bifurcation_walkway's `occupancy` translates into NONE of it: corridor, mural, inlay and vault draw the same 4800 dots from the same r window and differ only in which submanifold of the corridor they lie on. But bifurcation_walkway's OTHER axis translates perfectly. `regime` (:47, :152-158) crops r: at stable = 2.5..3.0 the logistic map has one attractor, so after skip_transient every recorded iteration in a column is the same number and the corridor's air is empty; at chaos = 3.57..4.0 the recorded iterations spread across most of the unit interval and the corridor fills. That is the cloud's question, asked of the same equation, by the same artifact, under a different name. So the two `occupancy` axes are two coordinates, the family is real, and the walkway has both while calling only one of them by the family word.

NO, occupancy AND regime ARE NOT THE SAME QUESTION on the walkway - the brief asked and the answer is a clean no. regime chooses the DOMAIN (which interval of r the twelve metres span, which is also which behaviour class is on show); occupancy chooses where the resulting set is drawn inside a fixed architecture. They are independent in the code: _apply_regime touches only r_min/r_max, _dot_position touches only positions, and _rebuild_data (:164-190) runs both. The relation between them is that regime is the walkway's answer to the CLOUD's occupancy question and occupancy is its answer to a question the cloud never asks.

FOUR THINGS FOUND BY READING, THREE OF THEM UNASKED FOR.

(1) THE TWO LISTS SHARE EXACTLY ONE VALUE, UNDER TWO NAMES, AND NOBODY NOTICED BECAUSE IT SITS IN THE TWO DIFFERENT COORDINATES. The walkway's `vault` lifts the dots to wall_height + 0.35 + x_val * 1.2, i.e. 3.35..4.55 m above a corridor whose walls stop at 3.0 (:264-267) - the set leaves the space that measures it. The cloud's `unboxed` deletes the glass box, the twelve glowing edge cylinders and the floor ticks (:163-164), and its own comment calls the result 'a quantity with no measure' (:29-30). Same move, opposite hands: one takes the set out of the box, the other takes the box away from the set. This bench's `lofted` is that value, and it is where the designed null lives.

(2) THE WALKWAY'S regime CARRIES AN ALL-RUNGS VALUE AND IT IS THE DEFAULT. `all` is 2.5..4.0, which strictly contains stable, cascade, chaos and period3 (REGIME_WINDOWS, :79-84), and the code comment says outright that it means 'do not touch r_min/r_max'. Waves 20-21 found nine of these in the corpus; this is one more, on a promoted axis, shipping. Registered here rather than fixed, since two live maps depend on that framing (registry dna.default). The four windows on this bench are disjoint on purpose: 2.60-2.95, 3.10-3.40, 3.45-3.57, 3.90-4.00, none containing another.

(3) THE WALKWAY'S TWO AXES ARE NOT INDEPENDENT AT `mural`, AND THE COUPLING SPLITS THE MATHEMATICS IN HALF. _dot_position picks which side wall a dot lands on from ITERATION PARITY - `side = -1.0; if (j % 2) == 0: side = 1.0` (:250-253) - and in every period-2 window the orbit value ALSO alternates with iteration parity. So at mural with regime=stable-through-cascade, the upper branch of the period-2 orbit lands entirely on one wall and the lower branch entirely on the other; at period-4, branches 1 and 3 go left and 2 and 4 go right. The artifact systematically sorts the attractor by iteration parity and photographs it as two half-diagrams. Nothing in the chain would catch it: it compiles, it declares correctly, and it renders a plausible picture.

(4) TWO OF THE CLOUD'S FIVE VALUES ARE STILL IN THE TIME DOMAIN. _build_all leaves _frozen at -1.0 for both `breath` and `unboxed`, so set_process stays on (:260-266) and the cloud radius at the shutter is lerpf(0.05, 0.45, 0.5 - 0.5*cos(_t*TAU/7)). pinched, packed and widened are frozen and reproducible; the other two are facts about when the frame was taken. Four of that artifact's ten pairs therefore depend on the capture's frame timing. This bench has no _process, no timer, no tween, no await and no RNG at all.

THE VOCABULARY, AND WHY IT IS NEITHER MEMBER'S. `occupancy` keeps the family word and is given the EXTENT coordinate, because that is what the word means in physics and in every other use of it in this corpus - an occupied fraction. Its four values name what the SET looks like at that fraction (hairline, forked, frayed, flooded), not what either artifact did to produce it, and each is a disjoint r window of the logistic map. `site` takes the walkway's coordinate and names it as a relation rather than as a building part: suspended, pressed, bedded, lofted, against corridor, mural, inlay, vault. That rename is the load-bearing claim - `corridor` and `vault` are nouns for parts of a building and reading them is what produces the mounting mistake, while `suspended` and `lofted` are relations a set can stand in to a container, which is a sentence the cloud's phase box can also be in.

THE THESIS SOMEONE CAN DISAGREE WITH: that a shared word can be honest about the QUESTION and still carry no shared answer, because the question had two coordinates and each member picked one. THE DISAGREEMENT AVAILABLE, and it is fair: a reader can say the walkway's four values plainly are architecture - a wall, a floor, a ceiling - and that calling them `site` is a rename that hides it. The answer is `inlay`, which changes which variable is on which axis, and `vault`, which is the same value as the cloud's `unboxed` in a different coordinate. An axis whose values include a re-mapping and a measure-destruction is not a list of mountings.

predicted_degeneracy.pair: site=pressed against site=bedded, in the hairline occupancy
predicted_degeneracy.metric: changed_pct on luma - the FRACTION OF PIXELS whose luma moves past the threshold, not a magnitude. That is the right metric here because the difference being predicted is pure geometry: identical spheres, identical colours, identical count, at two positions. Nothing in this pair is colour-only, so the wave-22 failure mode (six pairs tied at 12.994 percent because changed_pct cannot rank a colour change) does not apply.
predicted_degeneracy.denominator: FRAME, i.e. percent of the 760 x 760 render. Stated because a closest-pair claim inherits its denominator; the subject here (the instrument) is roughly 30 percent of frame, so a subject-denominated number would be about 3x larger.
predicted_degeneracy.floor_or_two_sided: FLOOR. It is flat-rectangle arithmetic on paper with one light, no shadows, no AO, no antialiasing and no bloom from an emission_energy 2.2 material. Every prediction in this corpus built that way has under-read, by 1.5x (grasp_cabinet), 1.7x (operations_gallery), 3.5x (noise_quarry) and 6.7x (removal_room). Expect 0.8 to 3.7 percent.
predicted_degeneracy.why:
WHY A SITE PAIR AND NOT AN OCCUPANCY PAIR. `site` is a rigid translation of one mark; `occupancy` ADDS marks. At hairline the attractor is a single value per column, so after 44 transient iterations all 56 recorded values in a column are equal to float precision and the drawing is ONE tube of overlapping spheres. At forked there are two. So every site pair at hairline moves 2 tubes and the smallest occupancy pair (hairline against forked) moves 3, plus a digit of readout. Nothing in the sheet moves fewer than 2 tubes.

WHY hairline. It is the only occupancy whose per-column value set is a single number, so it is the only one whose mark is a single tube. This is also why this bench cannot be scored on its headline: the peak pair (hairline against flooded at suspended) is a 0.752 x 0.424 m filled band against a hairline and computes to about 6.4 percent, more than eleven times the closest pair. READ THE PER-PAIR ROWS.

WHY pressed AND bedded OF THE SIX SITE PAIRS. All six move exactly 2 tubes of the same physical size, so the ranking is PERSPECTIVE and nothing else. Camera is capture_config_sweep's: RES 760, FOV 34, PAD 1.9, yaw 0.62, pitch -0.26 (capture_config_sweep.gd:67-71, :442-443), framing 0.58 from dna.framing. The union AABB is the instrument in all sixteen cells - 0.822 x 1.6012 x 0.48, diagonal 1.86276 m - so dist = (1.86276/2)/tan(17deg) * 1.9 * 0.58 = 3.35718 m and the camera sits at (1.88507, 1.66365, 2.64040) with the AABB centre at (0, 0.8006, 0). Tube depths: suspended (0, 0.84655, 0) at 3.34557 m, pressed (0, 0.84655, -0.172) at 3.48292 m, bedded (0, 0.514, 0.04517) at 3.40740 m, lofted (0, 1.22, 0) at 3.27445 m. pressed and bedded are the two FARTHEST from the camera, so their pair is the smallest.

THE ARITHMETIC. Frame height = diagonal * PAD * framing = 1.86276 * 1.9 * 0.58 = 2.05276 m, so 760 / 2.05276 = 370.24 px per metre at the AABB centre distance. A tube of overlapping spheres has silhouette 2r * L_projected: 2r = 0.020, L = USE_X = 0.752 m along x, and x.v = sin(0.62)cos(0.26) = 0.56151 so L_proj = 0.752 * sqrt(1 - 0.56151^2) = 0.62226 m. Silhouette = 0.0124451 m2. Scale to each depth: pressed 370.24 * 3.35718/3.48292 = 356.87 px/m gives 1585 px2; bedded 364.78 px/m gives 1656 px2. Total 3241 px2 of 577600 = 0.561 percent. The readout contributes ZERO - same occupancy, same string, and by design the board cannot move under site at all. The instrument contributes zero. Registered at 0.56.

THE MARGIN IS THIN AND THAT IS DECLARED. The runner-up, suspended against pressed at hairline, computes to 0.572 percent by the same arithmetic - 1.9 percent wider, which is inside this method's resolution. THE ORDERING IS NOT THE CLAIM; the magnitude is, and specifically that the closest live pair in a sixteen-cell sheet is under 1 percent on paper. If the sweep returns suspended-against-pressed or suspended-against-bedded as the closest instead, the prediction held.

IF ANY SITE PAIR COMES BACK AT 0.00 PERCENT, THAT IS NOT AN INERT AXIS. Both axes are String enums driven through _pick_axis, and Object.set() on a typed property of the wrong type is refused in SILENCE - read <out>/_rejects.json first, then check_dna_declarations.py, then whether the sheet was captured at --max=16 (build_dna_gallery's default cap of 9 trims the LATER axis, which is `site`, and at 9 a 4 x 4 renders as 4 x 2: suspended and pressed only, taking the entire designed null with it). If the sweep comes back BELOW 0.56 on the registered pair, stop and check the harness before the design - operations_gallery is the only artifact in the corpus to land under its own prediction and it was the only one that was broken.
predicted_degeneracy.registered: 2026-08-18, before any capture. No sweep and no capture were run by the builder.

designed_nulls.why:
IDENTICAL BY CONSTRUCTION, AND IT IS THE BENCH'S THESIS RATHER THAN A CHECK ON IT. Outside the box there is no state axis to be placed along, so `occupancy` has nothing to be an occupancy OF. _point_position's `lofted` branch discards v entirely and returns Vector3(x, BOX_FLOOR + BOX_H + LOFT_RISE, 0.0), so all 4928 points collapse onto 88 positions that depend only on the column index - and the column index does not depend on the r window. _build_readout takes the site != lofted branch, so both frames print 'OCCUPIED  --' over 'no box under it - the measure is undefined' and never call _occupied_fraction. The instrument (pedestal, glass box, twelve frame edges, two floor ticks, five ladder marks, readout board) reads neither axis. So these two cells are the same photograph, and the extreme pair of the axis at that: a single fixed point against a chaotic band filling the interval. Predicted 0.00 percent.

THIS IS A CONDITIONAL CROSS AND IT IS DECLARED SO NOBODY REPORTS IT AS A DEAD AXIS. All six occupancy pairs inside site=lofted are nulls. Group by VALUE PAIR across contexts, never by context mean: the same six pairs under suspended, pressed and bedded are the widest in the sheet.

ANYTHING ABOVE 0.3 PERCENT IS A HARNESS FAULT, not a finding, and there are only three places it can be: the sweep never set `site` (read _rejects.json - both axes are String enums), a read of occupancy leaked into the lofted path, or the sheet was trimmed so the two cells are not the ones named.

The same null taken on the two MIDDLE values, so the result cannot be an artifact of picking the two extremes. forked draws two branches and frayed draws four to sixteen when either is inside the box; at lofted both draw the same 88 stacked positions. Predicted 0.00 percent.

THE CONTRAST THAT MUST HOLD ALONGSIDE BOTH NULLS: the SAME two value pairs under site=suspended must be among the wider pairs in the sheet - forked is two tubes and frayed is a comb of four to sixteen filling roughly 48 percent of the state interval, so the pair moves an area of order 0.1 m2 against these nulls' zero. If forked and frayed are close under suspended too, then `occupancy` is not reaching the geometry either and the nulls mean nothing.

dna.designed_nulls_why:
TWO NULLS, BOTH THE SAME SENTENCE, AND THE SENTENCE IS THE SYNTHESIS. A quantity with no denominator is not small, it is undefined - so when the set leaves the box, the four occupancies must become one photograph. possibility_space_cloud says exactly this in prose at its own :29-30 and then does it by deleting the box; bifurcation_walkway does the geometric half by lifting the dots above the corridor at `vault`. Neither can show that the two moves are the same move, because neither has the other coordinate. Here they are one cell of a cross, and the null is what proves it.

NO OTHER CELL PAIR COLLAPSES, AND THAT WAS ENUMERATED RATHER THAN HOPED. Inside each of suspended, pressed and bedded the four occupancy values draw 1, 2, 4-to-16 and roughly 19 distinct bins per column - all different, and the readout prints a different integer for each. Across site at fixed occupancy the mark is translated by at least 0.1056 m in the image plane, which is 5.3 tube diameters, so no site pair overlaps. The only degeneracy in the sheet is the designed one.

NEITHER NULL IS CONDITIONED ON ANYTHING dna.fixture PINS. The fixture pins `emissive` only; both nulls are conditioned on site=lofted, which is swept.
dna.fixture_why:
THERE IS NOTHING ELSE TO PIN, AND THAT IS THE POINT RATHER THAN AN OMISSION. This file contains no RandomNumberGenerator, no randf, no noise, no _process, no Timer, no tween and no await. The logistic map is deterministic from x = 0.5, the transient is dropped by a fixed count, and every position is a closed-form function of the column index and the orbit value. A variant is the same object twice, with no seed to get wrong.

BOTH SOURCES NEEDED A SEED AND BOTH SAY SO. bifurcation_walkway scattered its z with a bare global randf() until 2026-08-03 and now seeds 20260803 at :276, its registry note recording in capitals that without it a sweep of occupancy would have been measuring the RNG. possibility_space_cloud called _rng.randomize() before promotion and now pins CLOUD_SEED 20260729 at :60, :91. This bench does not inherit the habit because it does not inherit the SCATTER - see declines.

WHAT IS PINNED is the one thing a placement can still change underneath the axes: `emissive`. curation_station passes {'emissive': false} to its contents, which drops every registered material's emission_energy_multiplier to 0.3x (possibility_space_cloud.gd:104-107 records what that cost the first time). Pinned true so all sixteen tiles are lit identically.
dna.framing_why: 0.58. The union AABB is the instrument - 0.822 wide (the box frame at +-0.411 beats the 0.496 readout board and the 0.48 pedestal), 1.6012 tall (ground to the top of the readout frame) and 0.48 deep (the pedestal, which is wider than the box) - diagonal 1.86276 m. capture_config_sweep fits by that diagonal with PAD 1.9 (:442), so at framing 1.0 the frame would be 3.539 m tall and the box interior, which is where both axes live, would be 16 percent of frame height. 0.58 puts the frame at 2.0528 m, the instrument at 78 percent of frame height and the box interior at 27 percent, with about 0.23 m of margin above and below. There are no Label3D nodes in this file, so LabelFramer adds nothing outside the measured box and the margin is real.
dna.kin:
The two sources are the kin and neither is a parent. bifurcation_walkway supplies the MATHEMATICS - x_{n+1} = r x_n (1 - x_n), one column per r, the transient dropped, which is _orbit_columns() here almost line for line - and the SITE coordinate. possibility_space_cloud supplies the BODY: the glass phase box with twelve glowing edge cylinders and crossed floor ticks (:178-187), the single MultiMesh of small emissive spheres (:190-205), the purple 0.6/0.5/0.95 instrument frame against a 0.4/0.55/1.0-to-0.55/0.95/1.0 state ramp, the steel pedestal and post (:171-172), and the TextScreen readout that turns the occupied fraction into a number you can read (:240-256). It also supplies the QUESTION, since 'how much of the space of what could be is filled' is its @identity truth.

ADJACENT WITHOUT THE WORD, and named for the census rather than for the geometry: bifurcation_diagram, which is the same equation drawn as a chart and shares `regime` with the walkway character for character; microstate_counter and macrostate_shelf, which count a possibility space instead of measuring it; ordered_grid, which the walkway's own @identity names as its contrast (fixed point against period doubling); shannon_entropy_meter, a size-of-the-space reading over symbol frequencies rather than states.

NOT KIN, CHECKED: the corpus's mounting words. `house` (white_cube|wunderkammer|depot|forensic) on exhibit_furniture is institutional genre, `mounting` in the cabinet grammar and `support`/`admission` are furniture words about how a prop is held. bifurcation_walkway's own dna.kin already rejected the last two by name for this axis. `site` is not a fifth of them: two of its four values change what the drawing MEANS (bedded rotates which variable is on which axis, lofted removes the denominator), which no mounting word does.
dna.was:
Nothing - this is a new body. What it WAS is a two-member family with zero shared values, which is a hypothesis that ought to be tested rather than assumed: either the word does real work or the two artifacts collided on it.

WHY THE VOCABULARY IS NEITHER MEMBER'S, WHICH IS THE THING THIS ENTRY HAS TO JUSTIFY. A synthesis of a family whose members share no answer cannot borrow either answer, because borrowing one is a vote for one member and the whole question is which of them the word belongs to. So the bench names the QUESTION and then splits it, because reading the two files is what shows the question has two independent parts.

`occupancy` keeps the family word and gets the EXTENT part - how much of the space of what could be is covered - on three grounds. It is what the word means in physics and in ordinary use; it is the coordinate possibility_space_cloud's five values all lie along; and it is the coordinate bifurcation_walkway ALSO has, under `regime`, so the shared word ends up naming the thing both members actually vary. Its four values - hairline, forked, frayed, flooded - describe what the SET looks like, not what an artifact did to it: they are readable off a photograph without knowing which file produced it, which is the test a family word has to pass. They are also disjoint r windows, so no value contains another.

`site` gets the walkway's coordinate and is renamed from building parts to RELATIONS. corridor, mural, inlay and vault are nouns for parts of a corridor, and that is precisely what makes the mounting misreading available; suspended, pressed, bedded and lofted are positions a set can hold relative to a container, and the cloud's 0.7 m phase box can be in every one of them. The rename is the argument: if the axis really is about where a set stands in the space that measures it, the words for it must survive being taken out of a building - and they do.

WHAT THE SPLIT COSTS, on the record: `occupancy` on this bench is narrower than on either source. It no longer means 'this artifact's four architectural treatments' and it no longer means 'and also whether the box exists'. Both of those were folded elsewhere - into `site`, and into `site=lofted`.
declines: THE SCATTER, both members', and it is the largest refusal here. bifurcation_walkway spreads its dots across +-0.6 * walkway_width in z at `corridor` and `vault` (:267, :270) from a seeded RNG. That scatter is decorative and it FAKES OCCUPANCY: at regime=stable every recorded iteration in a column is the same number, and the scatter draws those identical numbers as a 1.2 m wide cloud of forty dots. A corridor that contains a single attractor photographs as though it contains a cloud. Refused here - suspended and lofted put z at 0.0 - so identical values coincide, a period-1 attractor draws as one line, and `site` does exactly one thing: it moves the same marks to four places. Reported as a source finding rather than fixed there, because two live maps depend on that look.

THE WALKWAY'S HEIGHT-MAPPED `vault` (:264-267), which keeps y = wall_height + 0.35 + x_val * 1.2 so the diagram stays readable overhead. Refused: on this bench the box is the space of what could be and the readout is a fraction of it, so drawing the set outside the box WITH the box's state mapping would assert a measure the picture cannot support. This is where the two sources actually disagree - vault says out of reach, unboxed says out of measure - and the bench sides with unboxed and says so. The cost is declared: `lofted` is the one site where `occupancy` cannot be read, which is the designed null.

THE ALTERNATING-WALL TRICK at `pressed`. bifurcation_walkway's mural picks the wall from ITERATION parity, `side = -1.0; if (j % 2) == 0: side = 1.0` (:250-253), and in every period-2 window the orbit value alternates on the same parity - so the upper branch lands entirely on one wall and the lower entirely on the other, and the artifact photographs two half-diagrams. `pressed` puts the whole set on the far glass instead. Refused as a design, kept as a finding: it is in dna.note as item (3).

COLOURING BY r, which is what both the walkway (_get_color_for_r, :540-550) and bifurcation_diagram do. It would have made the four occupancy windows four different colours and given a reader a second explanation for every measured difference in the sheet - a geometry axis and a palette axis wearing one name. Colour here is the STATE value, so a fuller span shows more of the ramp and the colour change is a CONSEQUENCE of the extent rather than a channel beside it.

THE CLOUD'S `widened`, which grows the box by 1.4x and holds the cloud, moving the change into the DENOMINATOR. It is a real and good value and it is the third coordinate of the same question - vary the container instead of the set - and it was left out because two axes are what a sheet can hold and because at this bench's scale a 1.4x box would put the frame edges outside the AABB the framing was computed for. Named here so the next pass knows where it went.

THE CLOUD'S ANIMATION, `breath`, and with it any value that sweeps. A rate is invisible to one PNG - this is the info_board lesson, six identical tiles from five duration exports - and the source's own breath and unboxed leave set_process on (:260-266) so four of its ten pairs depend on the shutter. This file has no _process at all.

A THIRD AXIS FOR WHETHER THE BOX EXISTS, i.e. the cloud's `unboxed` promoted to its own knob. Refused as a near-duplicate of site=lofted: removing the box and removing the set from the box destroy the same denominator, and having both would have produced two ways to reach the same null and a sheet that cannot say which one it is testing.

AN `all` OR `full` OCCUPANCY SPANNING 2.5..4.0, which is bifurcation_walkway's shipped default and the natural fifth value. Refused as an ALL-RUNGS VALUE - it is the union of the other four and then some, the fault waves 20-21 found nine times. The four windows here are disjoint and the comparison is made by walking the axis, not by a value that contains it.

THE WALKWAY'S PLAYER COUPLING - the Area3D, the r readout that follows the body, the floor gradient that recolours under it (:473-534). It is that artifact's whole thesis and it is invisible to a headless still, which the source's own dna.gotcha already records: a capture always finds _current_r parked at r_min with the labels at the corridor entrance. Both axes here were chosen to be facts about built geometry, which is there whether or not anyone is walking.

A CONTINUOUS r KNOB. Numeric axis values outside CONFIG_PARAM_NAMES become `true` plus a rotation, silently, and there are 46 such collisions in the corpus already. Both axes here are non-numeric strings end to end.
dna.sweep_note: THE SHEET NEEDS --max=16 AND THE DEFAULT DESTROYS THE EXPERIMENT SILENTLY. `occupancy` is declared first and is never trimmed; `site` is second, and build_dna_gallery trims the LATER axis from the tail until the cross product fits its cap, which defaults to 9. At 9 a 4 x 4 renders as 4 x 2 - suspended and pressed only - so `bedded`, `lofted`, BOTH designed nulls and the registered closest pair all vanish, and what survives is eight handsome tiles of a bifurcation diagram in a vitrine, which is the family exactly as it already is.

dev_themes: one word given to two different coordinates of one question
a family whose members share no value because each varied a different half
a null that is a measure with its denominator removed
occupancy_cloud.capacity: SEE that `how full` and `where` are two independent readings of one space - and that the corpus's two-member `occupancy` family shares no value because each member varied one of them and called it the whole word
interactions: walk `occupancy` at site=suspended: a single line at hairline, two branches at forked, a widening comb at frayed, a filled band at flooded - and the readout climbing from roughly 4 percent to roughly 79 percent of the state interval

walk `site` at any occupancy below lofted: the same marks in the air, on the far glass, and laid on the floor with the value read across the depth instead of up the height. The picture changes completely and the number on the board does not move at all - that invariance is the whole argument

stand at site=lofted and walk `occupancy` through all four values. Nothing happens. The set is above the box that measures it, the board reads OCCUPIED --, and a stable system and a chaotic one are the same photograph

compare (hairline, suspended) with (hairline, bedded). One line, drawn twice, in two planes - the smallest live difference in the sheet, and the reason a source that scatters its identical values across a corridor can photograph an empty possibility space as a full one

compare the readout at (frayed, bedded) with the drawing beneath it. The comb has gaps; the number counts bins one drawn point across, so it reports the picture at the resolution the picture actually has, not the ideal set behind it

spatial_needs.footprint_note: THE INSTRUMENT IS THE FOOTPRINT AND NEITHER AXIS TOUCHES IT, checked value by value. The pedestal is a 0.24 m radius cylinder 0.08 tall, the post is 0.045 x 0.42 on top of it, the phase box is 0.80 x 0.56 x 0.38 centred at y 0.78 (floor 0.50, top 1.06) with 0.011 m frame cylinders, and the readout board is 0.496 x 0.3572 centred at y 1.4406 (top 1.6012). Everything either axis can draw is inside that: the state set spans x +-0.376 at every site, y 0.5392..1.0208 at suspended and pressed, y 0.514 at bedded, and y 1.22 at lofted - which is 0.06 m below the readout board's lower edge and therefore inside the AABB the board already sets. So NO layers = 0 anchor is needed, which is the one place bifurcation_walkway had to add one (:336-348), and the union AABB is 0.822 x 1.6012 x 0.48 in all sixteen cells.
